The architecture of the EXS0104 is shown in Fig. 1. The device does not require an extra input 
signal to control the direction of data flow from A to B or B to A. 
The EXS0104 is a "switch" type voltage translator, it employs two key circuits to enable voltage 
translation:

description: Dual supply translating transceiver; open drain; auto direction sensing

specs.param: VIH A port | VCC(A)=1.3–1.95 V / 2.3–5.5 V
VIH B port | VCC(B) 全范围

applications:
Voltage level-translation applications. The EXS0104 can be used in point-to-point applications 
to interface between devices or systems operating at different supply voltages. The device is 
primarily targeted at I2C or 1-wire which use open-drain drivers, it may also be used in 
applications where push-pull drivers are connected to the ports.
